from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9e100828.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 2 for rr, cc in ((r, c), (r, c + 1), (r + 1, c), (r + 1, c + 1))):
                corners = [(r - 1, c - 1), (r - 1, c + 2), (r + 2, c - 1), (r + 2, c + 2)]
                if not all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w for rr, cc in corners):
                    continue
                tl, tr, bl, br = (grid[rr][cc] for rr, cc in corners)
                colors = [bl, tl, br, tr]
                dirs = [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]
                for (rr, cc), color, (dr, dc) in zip(corners, colors, dirs):
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += dr
                        cc += dc
    return out
'''
